method: Actual records and prior source coverage read before source work; compact coordinator views were discovery aids. Exact records checked again during token binding. No historical snapshot status is treated as new-course teaching.
material_distinctions: sibb and wuldor were supplied in ch13, not productive; exact old nominative/sense IDs retained and promoted.
hund numeral is not hund dog; god deity and god-adjective are not gōd goods.
trēow, wiexð, hēah feminine and hēagum are exact source variants, not the previously selected trēo, wiext, hēa and hēaum.
Prior torr tower does not license reading crag; prior swīðra right does not license stronger; prior efne behold does not license emphatic just.
Prior high morphology does not silently introduce exalted human rank; explicit source sense supplied.
Weg in26.3 has explicit supplied figurative access meaning.
Hēah-adverb, be reference, lifetime on, people-domain on and speech tō are separately scoped by the grammar audit.
